entities.summary: Motobu Chōyū  was an Okinawan martial artist. He was also Ryukyuan royalty and the 11th sōke of the Motobu Udun (本部御殿), a branch of the Ryukyuan royal family. His younger brother was a karate master, Motobu Chōki.

entities.summary: Motobu Chōyū  was an Okinawan martial artist. He was also Ryukyuan royalty and the 11th sōke of the Motobu Udun (本部御殿), a branch of the Ryukyuan royal family. His younger brother was a karate master, Motobu Chōki.
